headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, securing a 14-5 victory. Henry Davis led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams. Keegan Akin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort for the Baltimore Orioles. The Arizona Diamondbacks placed Zac Gallen on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. Chris Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to right shoulder impingement.

Several trades and roster movements have occurred. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded Cam Sanders to the Orioles. The Milwaukee Brewers acquired Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox traded Brandon Eisert and Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Jaden Woods and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Brewers 14-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, securing a 14-5 victory. Henry Davis led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, marking a tough outing for the team. Leody Taveras led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Shane Baz pitched 4.2 strong innings for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI. Ryan Yarbrough earned the win for the Yankees, while Paul Blackburn secured the save.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Reds 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Alex Bregman leading the offense. Bregman hit 3 home runs, including a key 9th homer that scored two runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Update Player Status**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles left-hander Keegan Akin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. The move is a result of a status change.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Cam Sanders in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Cam Sanders, who was traded to the Orioles from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash.
